name: What types of replacement window frames are resistant to warping?

mainEntity.name: What types of replacement window frames are resistant to warping?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fiberglass and composite window frames are highly resistant to warping due to their stable composition and low expansion/contraction rates. Fiberglass frames offer excellent durability and can withstand extreme temperature fluctuations without distorting. Composite frames, made from a blend of materials, also provide superior stability and resistance to moisture. While wood and vinyl can warp under certain conditions, higher-quality versions with proper construction and installation, such as those with aluminum cladding or reinforced vinyl, offer enhanced stability.
